def assert_current_tree(capture, tree_sha, label):
    actual, _ = capture.git(["write-tree"], label=label+"-index", auth=False)
    check(actual.decode("ascii").strip() == tree_sha, "index changed from frozen source tree")
    capture.git(["diff", "--exit-code", tree_sha, "--"], label=label+"-worktree", auth=False)
    others, _ = capture.git(["ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"], label=label+"-untracked", auth=False)
    check(others == b"", "unregistered source outputs appeared")
    inventory, _ = capture.git(["ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", tree_sha],
                               label=label+"-frozen-paths", auth=False)
    observed = []
    failures = []
    checked_parents = set()
    for item in inventory.split(b"\0"):
        if not item:
            continue
        header, raw_path = item.split(b"\t", 1)
        expected_mode, kind, expected_blob = header.decode("ascii").split()
        relative = relative_path(raw_path.decode("utf-8"))
        row = {"path": relative.as_posix(), "expected_mode": expected_mode,
               "expected_blob": expected_blob}
        try:
            check(kind == "blob" and expected_mode in {"100644", "100755", "120000"},
                  "unsupported frozen source entry")
            path = capture.repo / relative
            parent = path.parent
            while parent not in checked_parents:
                check(stat.S_ISDIR(parent.lstat().st_mode), "source parent is not a plain directory")
                checked_parents.add(parent)
                if parent == capture.repo:
                    break
                check(parent != parent.parent, "source path escaped repository")
                parent = parent.parent
            info = path.lstat()
            if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
                raw = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path))
                actual_mode = "120000"
            else:
                check(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode), "source is not a regular file")
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                actual_mode = "100755" if info.st_mode & 0o111 else "100644"
            row.update(bytes=len(raw), actual_mode=actual_mode,
                       actual_blob=oid("blob", raw), sha256=sha(raw))
            check(actual_mode == expected_mode and row["actual_blob"] == expected_blob,
                  "physical source bytes or mode differ from frozen tree")
        except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
            row["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
            failures.append(row["path"])
        observed.append(row)
    capture.json("checks/" + label + "-raw-worktree.json", {
        "scope": "EACH_FROZEN_PATH_READ_INDEPENDENTLY_OF_GIT_STAT_CACHE",
        "frozen_tree": tree_sha, "files": observed, "failures": failures,
    })
    check(not failures, "raw source readback differs from frozen tree: " + ", ".join(failures[:10]))

def regenerate(capture, inputs):
    for index, command in enumerate(inputs["pre_generation_commands"]):
        python_command(capture, command, "pre-generation-" + str(index), limit=300)
    for index, name in enumerate(inputs["generators"]):
        check(re.fullmatch("[a-z0-9_]+", name) is not None, "invalid generator module")
        python_command(capture, ["-m", "tools.generate_hia_" + name],
                       "generate-" + str(index) + "-" + name, limit=300)
    retired = []
    for pin in inputs["physical_migration"]:
        old = capture.repo / relative_path(pin["path"])
        target = capture.repo / relative_path(pin["target"])
        check(oid("blob", old.read_bytes()) == pin["blob"], "legacy source changed during generation")
        check(target.is_file() and not target.is_symlink(), "canonical output not generated")
        target_data = target.read_bytes()
        if pin["action"] == "retained-prefix-complete-program":
            check(old.is_file() and not old.is_symlink(), "retained fragment became non-ordinary")
            relation = check_materialization_extension(pin, old.read_bytes(), target)
            capture.json("physical-migration/retained-prefix-retirement.json", relation)
        if pin["action"] == "relocate-exact-bytes" and not pin["target"].startswith("examples/hia_bootstrap/"):
            check(oid("blob", target_data) == pin["blob"], "non-generated physical relocation changed bytes")
        retired.append({"old_path": pin["path"], "old_blob": pin["blob"],
                        "target": pin["target"], "target_blob": oid("blob", target_data),
                        "target_bytes": len(target_data), "development_tree_only": True})
        old.unlink()
    capture.json("physical-migration/COMPLETED.json", retired)
    capture.git(["add", "-A"], label="stage-generated-path-inventory", auth=False)
    for index, command in enumerate(inputs["post_generation_commands"]):
        python_command(capture, command, "post-generation-" + str(index), limit=300)
    capture.git(["add", "-A"], label="stage-regenerated-candidate", auth=False)
    tree, _ = capture.git(["write-tree"], label="regenerated-tree", auth=False)
    tree_sha = tree.decode("ascii").strip()
    check(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{40}", tree_sha) is not None, "invalid generated tree identity")
    for index, name in enumerate(inputs["generators"]):
        python_command(capture, ["-m", "tools.generate_hia_" + name],
                       "reproduce-" + str(index) + "-" + name, limit=300)
    for index, command in enumerate(inputs["reproduction_commands"]):
        python_command(capture, command, "reproduce-post-" + str(index), limit=300)
    assert_current_tree(capture, tree_sha, "exact-regeneration-readback")
    for index, command in enumerate(inputs["final_inventory_commands"]):
        python_command(capture, command, "final-inventory-" + str(index), limit=300)
    capture.git(["add", "-A"], label="stage-final-inventory", auth=False)
    tree, _ = capture.git(["write-tree"], label="final-source-tree", auth=False)
    tree_sha = tree.decode("ascii").strip()
    return {"tree": tree_sha, "generator_count": len(inputs["generators"]),
            "real_generation_passes": 2, "physical_paths_retired_in_development_tree": len(retired)}
exact_reviewed_function_source.write_source:
def write_source(capture, path, raw, mode):
    relative = relative_path(path)
    check(mode in ("100644", "100755"), "unsupported authored mode")
    target = capture.repo / relative
    for parent in target.parents:
        if parent == capture.repo:
            break
        check(not parent.is_symlink(), "symlink source ancestor")
    check(not target.is_symlink(), "symlink source target")
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target.exists():
        before = target.read_bytes()
        capture.put("preimages/" + oid("blob", before) + "/" + path, before)
    target.write_bytes(raw)
    target.chmod(0o755 if mode == "100755" else 0o644)

findings.fact: Writes the reviewed bytes and chmods 0755 for 100755, otherwise 0644. This establishes initial mode, not a later pre-read admission check.
Legacy source admission uses source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink(), then reads and checks the Git blob. It does not lstat/S_IMODE==0644 the original path.
Retirement first reads and checks the original blob, then for the extension checks is_file/not_symlink and passes old bytes to the extension helper. There is no strict0644 original-path check.
Its general Git-tree mode comparison classifies ordinary files as 100755 if any executable bit is set, otherwise 100644; it does not assert a full POSIX permission mask of 0644.

limits: This report does not claim an executed exploit of the old-source path, a filesystem race guarantee, or product/native qualification.
scope: Read-only static original-path admission review; no added product or harness-path execution
